newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel escapes downtrend, seeks 129.38.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel escapes downtrend, seeks 129.38.

text.p: The June notionnel contract will keep on rallying on Wednesday following its escape from a short-term downtrend on Tuesday, analysts said.
Francoise Skelley, head of global trading technical analysis at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said the downtrend had come in at 128.66.
"The break of the short-term downtrend will give it a fillip to the upside for the next few days," she said.
At 0724 GMT the June futures were up 0.16 at 129.06.
Skelley said the market would aim for the April 17 high of 128.38 in the short term, then shoot for 129.86-92.
Skelley said she doubted the market would get past 129.38 on the first attempt. "But a break above there will target 129.86-92," she said.
The 129.86 level was a a 61.8 percent retracement of the decline from 131.58 in February to 127.06 on April 4.
After that, 129.92 marked the top of a rising channel line, Skelley said. She saw support coming in at 128.80 and 128.64.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said in a resarch note that daily indicators were on the verge of crossing, pointing to 96.44. The market has channel support at 96.25, the bank said.
